About Sal's

Quality plumbing since 1979

Sal's Plumbing is a family owned plumbing business located in Torrance. For over 40 years we have served the South Bay, Long Beach and Los Angeles with competitive rates, fast and friendly service, and professional workmanship.

Fully licensed, bonded and insured — and financing options are available for large jobs through our partner U.S. Bank, so a big repair never has to wait.
